description: Ranking experimental: usable only to prioritize local research, not to make investment decisions.
No out-of-sample predictive validation is available for the global ranking.
Country coverage is partial and depends on real data adapters already built.
Some jurisdictions remain not yet scored because no real ratios/growth adapter exists.
Assets with less than contractual coverage remain blocked and visible, never imputed.
Financial institutions require a separate factor contract before scoring.
Some otherwise useful assets lack real price coverage and remain outside the main ranking.
The surface is not authorized for automatic buy/sell/hold recommendations or broker workflows.
